purpose: Victim assistance and voluntary advocacy resources plus source-linked history of Stanford-related proceedings, independently of complaint dispatch.
constraints: No individual victim names or contact details collected. Use organization-level intake, consent-based support, and confidential evidence channels; support groups are not distribution lists.

Historical proceedings are not evidence of the truth of the current allegations. Distinguish Stanford University, Stanford Health Care, and pediatric institutions; distinguish regulators, plaintiffs/counsel, archives, reporting, and historical participants.

Only an appropriate agency with jurisdiction should receive specific allegations through established complaint channels. Historical-case-only records are evidence references, not outreach targets. No automatic dispatch or unrelated agencies contacted.

Where original survey reports or court dispositions are unavailable, record limits. For AHCJ entries, the source is an archive of CMS records; confirm official reports and correction plans through CDPH or CMS. No inference of continuing noncompliance from historic deficiencies.
Open status is as reported by source, not a current determination or finding. Public case information not exhaustive. No implied endorsement or coalition membership.
